scripts.build: npm run build -w @workspace/client-sdk && npm run build -w @workspace/api && npm run build -w @workspace/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @workspace/client-sdk && npm run build -w @workspace/client-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @workspace/api && npm run typecheck -w @workspace/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @workspace/api" "npm run dev -w @workspace/web"
scripts.dev:test: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:test -w @workspace/api" "npm run dev -w @workspace/web"
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run openapi:generate -w @workspace/api && npm run generate -w @workspace/client-sdk && prettier --write contracts/openapi.json packages/client-sdk/src/generated/openapi.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
